summary: Phase 11 multi-round betting validation against live backend. All 11 target features (F1-F11) PASS. Authored /app/backend/tests/test_phase11_validation.py with 8 pytest cases covering seat-cap derivation, two-human BETTING_R1 join+start, full canonical phase progression (BETTING_R1 -> DRAW_1 -> BETTING_R2 -> DRAW_2 -> BETTING_R3 -> PAYOUT), HIT/STAND reachability, BET/CALL/FOLD short-circuit to PAYOUT, PLAY_TEN gateway acceptance, card privacy (public STATE_UPDATE carries only card_count; PRIVATE_STATE is per-user only), target=100 5-seat TABLE_FULL, disconnect/reconnect PRESENCE events. Frontend lobby smoke (login, create, seats-derived) verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: F10 connect-timeout (10s) once during a 72s full run; retry succeeded immediately. Likely preview ingress/Kubernetes cold path. Not a backend defect.

issues: Grows unbounded with prior test tables; no pagination/sorting control. Low priority.

action_items: No code changes required per user directive; all 11 phase-11 acceptance checks green against live backend.
Optional: add periodic cleanup of stale LOBBY-status tables with 0 seats, since the open-tables list accumulates across test runs.
critical_code_review_comments: bridge._public_state_payload correctly emits only card_count at L84; PRIVATE_STATE is published exclusively to per-user topic 'table:{id}:user:{user_id}' (bridge.py L436). Card privacy is sound.

gateway.py L341: CLIENT_ACTIONS whitelist accepts PLAY_TWO/PLAY_TEN; engine-level rejection (e.g. NO_TRIGGER_CARD / NOT_YOUR_TURN) flows through ACTION_ACK with result.accepted=false instead of UNKNOWN_TYPE. Matches F6 requirement.
lobby/router.CreateTableRequest correctly marks max_players / min_players as IGNORED (L61-62). Verified by sending max_players=10 with target=30 -> server returns max_players=4.
reconnect-grace: bridge.notify_disconnect publishes a PRESENCE event synchronously with connected=false + grace_seconds; notify_connect re-broadcasts PRESENCE connected=true. Both observed in F7.
engine phase sequence observed end-to-end matches GAME_RULES_LOCKED.md canonical flow. DRAW_2 is entered even when both players STAND in DRAW_1 (engine auto-advances through DRAW_2 into BETTING_R3).
Open lobby list grows unbounded because tests create many LOBBY-status tables. Consider a TTL/cron sweep in lobby.service for dev/preview envs.
test_credentials: Guest auth only: POST /api/v2/lobby/auth {username: <rand>} returns {user_id, token}. Tokens last 12h. No seeded credentials needed.
seed_data_creation: None persistent; every test registers fresh TEST_* guest users. Test-created LOBBY tables remain in the open-tables list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app/backend/tests && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://gracious-raman-3.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest test_phase11_validation.py -v. F5+F8 combined test takes ~23s (serial multi-round flow). F3+F4+F11 takes ~20s. F10 opens 6 WS-less REST connections; can transient-timeout on first auth call - retry. All tests use the real WS endpoint wss://.../api/v2/ws/table/{id}?token=...; websockets>=15 required. The backend env has TARGET_ALLOW_BOTS=1 and TARGET_BOT_COUNT_MAX=3.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. Phase 11 P0 multi-round betting is functioning correctly end-to-end (lobby config, seat-derivation, phase machine, HIT/STAND, BET/CALL/FOLD, PLAY_TEN gateway, presence grace, payout winners+deltas, card privacy, target-100 TABLE_FULL, and DRAW_2 presence).
